name: adamson/feature-grid
title: Feature grid
description: Section header and a grid of cards: photo cards (with an image) or numbered text cards (without). For reasons, services, venue types, partners.

fields.label: Number the text cards
fields.help: Shows 01, 02 … on cards without a photo.

fields.label: Small label
fields.help: Above the title, e.g. a region or a category.

fields.label: Link
fields.help: Optional. Makes the whole card clickable.

fields.label: Photo
fields.help: Optional. With a photo the card becomes a tall photo card.
